versions.changelog: Added Web App link - 合规通在线检测工具

Initial release: Chinese SEO compliance checker with real API backend. Features: API-powered banned word detection (200+ words), platform-specific SEO rules for Baidu/Xiaohongshu/Douyin/Taobao/JD, safe replacement suggestions, keyword density analysis, executable check.sh and suggestions.sh scripts. Free tier: 20 checks/month.
